title: A Systematic Survey of Prompt Engineering on Vision-Language Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that evaluates demographic representation in text-to-image model outputs (e.g., observing models generating only male-appearing persons for occupational prompts like 'firefighters') and summarizing debiasing strategies such as data preprocessing, training constraints, and post-processing.

Reviewing literature that analyzes racial representation in vision-language model generations (e.g., observing predominantly white persons generated for specific prompts) and surveying associated bias mitigation pipelines.
